material_findings.finding: Historical tool dispatch still resolves unknown model output through aliases/fuzzy matching and then invokes handlers directly; shell/run-script/app-close/memory-forget expose high-impact effects protected mainly by string/name heuristics and local checks.

Harness must prove that unknown/fuzzy text cannot bind execution authority and that destructive-equivalent effects remain impossible through shell, child process, FFI, script, process-control or memory-mutation paths.
